ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted against high-intensity (white) regions on the distal tips and right interior lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patch on the upper medial-to-lateral region of the right lobe; localized white clusters on the far distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow acute angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular sharp-peaked serrations and U-shaped valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the high-contrast water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward concave sweep along the trailing edge, terminating in sharp, tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel aggregates localized on the extreme left and right distal margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips; distinct white circular scar on the upper-right quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme fringe-like texture on distal tips caused by concentrated biological colonization.
